title: Enter results
purpose: Enter awaiting results or new revisions of entered/returned work in a page-sized grid, then submit saved entries from the batch page.

sections.title: Access
paragraphs: These are staff pages. Active users with an application staff role can read them; client accounts cannot. Analysts perform result entry and batch work, reviewers decide results, and administrators maintain configuration. Administrators also have operational analyst and reviewer access, but independence rules still apply. Superuser status alone does not grant an application role.

items.label: Search
items.description: Partial, case-insensitive lab ID, client sample ID or analyte, across eligible current results in this batch.

items.label: Status
items.description: Defaults to All that need entry: awaiting, entered and returned. Choose Awaiting entry, Entered, not submitted or Returned. Submitted/approved results do not appear; use the result page or import for approved corrections.

items.label: Apply
items.description: Filter and return to page 1. Invalid filters produce errors and no rows.

items.label: Clear all
items.description: Restore the default enterable set.

items.label: Rows per page
items.description: 25 by default; choose 50 or 100. Paging preserves filters. Save before changing filters or page: unsaved entries are lost.

items.label: Default analysis start
items.description: Optional common laboratory-local start used only by rows without their own Analysis start.

items.label: Sample
items.description: Read-only laboratory sample ID.

items.label: Analyte
items.description: Read-only requested analyte.

items.label: Prepared aliquot
items.description: Explicit preparation choice; required where configured. Available choices are noncancelled aliquots linked to this requested test; the server validates their method and chronology.

items.label: Unit
items.description: Read-only test unit; no conversion.

items.label: Current
items.description: Latest supplied numeric value, or ND with its applied reporting-limit threshold, and current status. New fields are not populated from it.

items.label: Soil basis
items.description: For soil only, choose Wet weight or Dry weight. Not applicable is shown among choices but is rejected for a new soil observation.

items.label: Supplied percent solids (optional)
items.description: Expand Percent solids and Solids source reference for soil.

items.label: Percent solids
items.description: Optional supplied exact percentage; requires a source.

items.label: Solids source reference
items.description: Required with supplied solids, at most 240 characters; identifies the actual measurement/source.

items.label: Result
items.description: Number or ND as observed. To skip a row, leave Result, Reporting limit and its row Analysis start all blank; a prefilled limit makes the row an attempted entry.

items.label: Reporting limit
items.description: Applied limit for this observation. Initially the current method limit if configured; check and edit as needed. With browser scripting, entering a positive whole-number dilution multiplies that base limit until you manually edit the limit. Fractional dilution does not auto-calculate it.

items.label: Dilution
items.description: Initially 1. Record the actual positive factor.

items.label: Qualifiers
items.description: Optional active, case-sensitive codes separated by commas, semicolons or whitespace. Duplicates are removed; unknown/inactive codes are errors.

items.label: Analysis start
items.description: Required per entered row unless Default analysis start is supplied. Row value overrides the default.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Shown for a result that already has a revision. Required for correction of returned/approved work; a draft revision without a reason receives the recorded reason Entry revised before submission.

items.label: How to enter results
items.description: Collapsed above the grid: how to type results (exact text, ND for a non-detect), the reporting-limit default, units and time zone, and the active qualifier codes with descriptions. Codes marked for holding-time exceedance can satisfy the exceeded-time submission requirement. On a soil batch the weight-basis rule stays visible above it.

items.label: Returned row
items.description: A result returned by review shows a Returned line under its row with the reviewer's reason and name. Enter it again with a reason.

sections.title: Exact results and chronology
paragraphs: Use a plain decimal number, optionally signed or in scientific notation, or ND (case-insensitive) for a non-detect. Zero is a detected numeric observation, never an inferred non-detect. Comparison symbols, units, thousands separators and values needing rounding are rejected. Result text is limited to 60 characters; numeric observations support 14 integer digits and 10 decimal places.

Reporting limit must be positive. Dilution must be positive with at most four decimal places and at most ten integer digits. A detected value below its applied reporting limit needs at least one active qualifier or must be entered as ND where appropriate; the application does not choose that interpretation for you. Units come from the test; nothing is converted.

Analysis cannot precede sample receipt or applicable preparation, and cannot be more than two minutes ahead of the current time. Preparation cannot precede collection, including composite end. Local form times use the deployment’s laboratory time zone; ambiguous/nonexistent daylight-saving local times are rejected.

For soil, choose Wet weight or Dry weight for every new observation. Enter the final result and reporting limit on that same basis; no conversion is performed. Percent solids is optional exact supplied data between 0 and 100 inclusive, and requires its source reference. A reference without percent solids is invalid. Nonsoil results use Not applicable and reject supplied solids metadata.

An active independent preparation requirement needs an explicit available aliquot for this sample/test, matrix and required preparation method/version. It must have a recorded start, and analysis cannot precede completion when recorded, otherwise start. Choosing the same aliquot means repeat analysis; choosing a new physical aliquot means re-preparation. No identity is inferred from a legacy batch timestamp.

items.label: Save … rows on this page as entered
items.description: Analysts save attempted rows on this page only. Every saved observation becomes a new entered revision and retains previous entries; it does not submit for review. A save with no attempted entries produces an error.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Return to the batch without saving typed values.

items.label: Row errors
items.description: If any submitted row is invalid, nothing in this save is committed. Errors link to affected rows and preserve typed values. A row is skipped only when its Result, Reporting limit and row Analysis start are all blank. Clear an initial method limit as well as the result to skip that row.

items.label: Changed rows
items.description: If a submitted result is no longer an eligible current result of this batch, nothing is saved. Reload, check current rows and enter again; do not assume unsaved values survive reload.

items.label: Preparation time needed
items.description: Resolve the linked missing preparation start before entry; a result entered without a required clock event cannot be submitted until re-entered with the correct event.

sections.title: Empty states
paragraphs: Clear filters if no rows match. Nothing to enter can mean no tests or all tests are submitted/approved. Add tests from the batch where appropriate. Returned rows are supported by this grid and the result page. Other staff can inspect the disabled entry form but cannot save it.
